result.response:
The bug has been analyzed and resolved.

### Root Cause
In [`QueryParser.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jsoup_21_group_b_fix/src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/QueryParser.java), group combinator commas (`,`) were handled separately inside `parse()` by splitting the remainder of the query using `tq.chompTo(",")`. This caused commas inside attribute values (e.g. `[name=1,2]`) or pseudo-selector parameters (e.g. `:matches([0-9,]+)`) to be incorrectly treated as group delimiters, leading to `PatternSyntaxException` and incorrect evaluation order.

### Fix
1. Updated [`QueryParser.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jsoup_21_group_b_fix/src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/QueryParser.java) to route `,` through the standard combinator mechanism `combinator(char)` rather than eagerly chomping to `,` in `parse()`. This allows `consumeSubQuery()` to respect nested brackets and parentheses via `chompBalanced`.
2. Implemented `,` handling in `combinator(char)` to construct or append to [`CombiningEvaluator.Or`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jsoup_21_group_b_fix/src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/CombiningEvaluator.java).
3. Added a package-private default constructor `Or()` to [`CombiningEvaluator.Or`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jsoup_21_group_b_fix/src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/CombiningEvaluator.java).

### Verification
- Both failing tests in [`SelectorTest`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jsoup_21_group_b_fix/src/test/java/org/jsoup/select/SelectorTest.java) (`handlesCommasInSelector` and `mixCombinatorGroup`) pass.
- Full test suite passes with zero regressions.
- Generated focused patch file [nl_fix.patch](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jsoup_21_group_b_fix/nl_fix.patch).
